The hamster has patches of white, brown, and grey fur. Notably, there are strange greenish-yellow artifacts near the head/ear region that resemble melting or foreign objects.

artifact_observations.reasoning: A distinct, bright greenish-yellow object is fused into the hamster's head/ear area. It lacks fur texture, appears smooth/plastic-like, and does not belong to any known hamster anatomy. This suggests a severe generation error where the model failed to render the ear correctly, resulting in a melted or foreign object fusion.

The right ear area shows discoloration (pinkish/yellow) and lacks clear definition, blending unnaturally into the fur. It looks like a smudge or partial melting compared to the rest of the fur texture.
Standard depth-of-field blur, likely intentional, but edges between the hamster and background show slight haloing/bleeding typical of AI generation.
